sources.title: Introducing Ternary Bonsai 2 2B, 4B, and 9B: Bringing Local ... - PrismML
sources.snippet: Today, we're expanding the Bonsai 2 family with three new ternary models based on Qwen3.5: Ternary Bonsai 2 2B, 4B, and 9B. Joining Bonsai 2 27B, they bring stronger capabilities to smaller deployment footprints and give developers more choices for building AI applications within local devices.

sources.title: GitHub - young-geng/EasyLM: Large language models (LLMs) made easy ...
sources.snippet: EasyLM is built with JAX/Flax. By leveraging JAX's pjit utility, EasyLM is able to train large models that don't fit on a single accelerator by sharding the model weights and training data across multiple accelerators. Currently, EasyLM supports multiple TPU/GPU training in a single host as well as multi-host training on Google Cloud TPU Pods.
